title: The Trailer
summary: A 2½-minute trailer recorded entirely from the game, flown live from Earth orbit to splashdown under the real Apollo 11 air-to-ground, with its own page and a link from the menu. A landed LM also no longer sits on bare ground.

title: The Real Voices
summary: Twenty lines of the real Apollo 11 air-to-ground play at the moments they happened, captioned: GO for TLI, the 1202s, 60 and 30 seconds, contact light, the Eagle has landed, and one small step.

title: The Landing, As It Happened
summary: Program alarms 1202, 1202 and 1201 on the way down, a boulder field at the computer's landing site, LPD redesignation, and the fuel calls.

title: V4.0: Apollo 11, Rewritten
summary: A from-scratch rewrite around a nine-chapter campaign with flight-director cues: real targeting for every burn, E-guidance powered descent, ascent, rendezvous and docking, and a lifting entry, each graded 0-3 stars.

title: Full Apollo Stack: CSM + LM
summary: Two independently simulated craft: undock the LM, fly a powered descent to a lunar touchdown, jettison the descent stage, ride the APS back to orbit, rendezvous and hard-dock with the CSM. S-IVB third stage (real J-2 numbers) flies TLI and gets staged away. Verified end-to-end: landing at 278 kg of DPS fuel, ascent to a 331x296 km lunar orbit, crew transfer, TEI home.

title: V3.0: The Merge
summary: Unified the two lineages: the Apollo feature build (Moon + SOI patched conics, maneuver nodes, orbit-ops assists, navball, map view, star catalog, coastlines, audio) now runs on the modern Vite + TypeScript architecture. One canonical main branch again.

title: V2 Vector Console Rebuild (Branch)
summary: Rebuilt the simulator as a modern Vite + TypeScript app on the v2-vector-console branch: SI-unit RK4 physics with atmospheric drag, zero-drift on-rails time warp to 100,000x, fuel/delta-v budget, and a mission chain ending in reentry splashdown. Candidate architecture for migrating the Apollo feature set off the legacy script-tag stack.

title: Use Finite Plain-line Maneuver Burns
summary: Replaced instant maneuver execution with finite SPS burns, removed the remaining shader-style atmosphere helper, and slowed attitude inputs for cleaner CRT line motion.

title: Trigger Auto Burns At Ignition Time
summary: Changed auto-burn execution to trigger at ignition time, centering planned burns around the maneuver node.

title: Arm Future Maneuver Burns
summary: Made future maneuver burns arm and count down instead of instantly jumping the spacecraft to the node.

title: Maneuver Alignment Guidance
summary: Added burn-vector alignment guidance, ignition timing, and pointing error readouts so planned nodes connect directly to spacecraft attitude.

title: Direct Maneuver Node Placement
summary: Added click-to-place maneuver nodes on the orbit line, scene markers, map connectors, and a maneuver cue on the navball.

title: Intuitive Maneuver Node Editor
summary: Added a MechJeb-style maneuver editor with prograde, normal, radial, TIG, AP/PE placement, predicted orbit, and burn timing.

title: Maneuver Planning And Flight Display Controls
summary: Added the first maneuver planning pass with flight display controls, predicted orbit telemetry, and burn execution.

title: Roadmap For Clean CRT Display Target
summary: Updated the roadmap around a clean CRT display target and Apollo mission-control visual direction.
